Task Board

Version

15.20.7a5cc9
November 24, 2025
Winter Update 2025

Status

Active
The Task Board allows players to take on Bounty Tasks and Weekly Tasks, each having different reward currency that can be spent in different ways.

Bounty Tasks

You can take tasks for hunting specific creatures, and earn Bounty Points. These points can be used to upgrade the Bounty Talisman, reroll tasks, and manage preferred or avoided creatures. There is also a chance of rolling:

  • Silver Tasks - 2x Exp Reward and Bounty Points.
  • Gold Tasks - 4x Exp Reward and Bounty Points.

When a creature is selected for the Bounty Task, an icon will appear besides its name. This can be helpful to differentiate creatures that share the same name with their summons, like Acid Blobs, since summon kills do not count as progress.

Bounty Points Reroll Tokens Kill Amount Range
Beginner Tasks 3 1 50-100
Adept Tasks 7 1 100-200
Expert Tasks 16 1 200-400
Master Tasks 27 1 300-600

Bounty Ring Upgrade

  • Damage Against Creature - to a maximum of 50%
    • This also influences Damage Prey effects
  • Life Leech - to a maximum of 50%
  • More Loot - to a maximum of 50%
  • Chance for Double Bestiary progress - to a maximum of 100%

Weekly Tasks

Every week, resetting on Mondays, players will reroll which weekly tasks are available for them. There are two types of tasks: Kill Tasks and Delivery Tasks, of which 6 of each type can be completed per week. If a character has bought the Permanent Weekly Task Expansion in the Store, this number is increased to 9 per week.

Weekly Task Rewards

Completing weekly tasks offers three types of rewards.

Experience

On completing a Delivery Task, your character will immediately receive some experience points. If your character is level 82 or lower, you will receive experience points equal to 50% of a level. If your character is level 1000 or higher, you will receive experience points equal to 4% of a level. The number of experience points can also be found by using this formula:

Exp = { 25 L 2 − 75 L + 100 , if  82 ≥ L R O U N D ( 1994.008 L ) , if  82 < L < 1000 2 L 2 − 6 L + 8 , if  L ≥ 1000 {\displaystyle {\text{Exp}}={\begin{cases}25L^{2}-75L+100,&{\text{if }}82\geq L\\ROUND(1994.008L),&{\text{if }}82<L<1000\\2L^{2}-6L+8,&{\text{if }}L\geq 1000\\\end{cases}}}

On completing a kill task, you will also receive experience points determined by the same rules and formula as the delivery tasks, but with an additional constraint. Beginner kill tasks are capped at 200,000 exp, adept kill tasks are capped at 800,000 exp and expert kill tasks are capped at 3,000,000 exp. There is no exp cap for master kill tasks.

Hunting Task Points

After the week ends, you will receive a number of hunting task points, determined by how many tasks you completed. Each delivery task gives you 75 points, and each kill task gives you points depending on the difficulty: 25 for beginner, 50 for adept, 100 for expert and 110 for master. Additionally, the points you receive will be multiplied by the reward multiplier, which increases as you complete more tasks. This multiplier is 2x for 4 tasks, 3x for 8 tasks, 5x for 12 tasks and 8x for 16 tasks.

Thus, if you complete all 18 tasks, as beginner you will receive 7,200 points, as adept you will receive 9,000 points, as expert you will receive 12,600 points and as master you will receive 13,320 points.

Soulseals

After the week ends, you will receive 1 Soulseal for each completed task. Soulseals can be used in the Soulpit. Click the obelisk there, then your character to open a menu where you can select a creature you want to challenge on your own.

The following achievements can be gained through completing tasks and spending points:
